title: How a Man of God Pays Back a Friend Before He Has to Ask
caption:
He covered you for the concert. Then the pizza. Then gas on the road trip. He hasn't brought it up, but he remembers.

The way you handle money you owe a friend says more about you than how you talk about God on Sunday. Same guy everywhere means same guy with his Venmo.

Write it down the day you borrow. Pay him before you pay yourself. If you can't, tell him before he has to ask. And don't round down the small ones.

"The wicked borrows but does not pay back, but the righteous is generous and gives." Psalm 37:21

Save this. Then go check who you still owe.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #integrity #friendship
